boundary=fixture['synthetic_boundary']()
model=lt._Model(boundary.initial_mass)
bnd=dict(r0=boundary.departure_position/lt.DU_KM,v0=boundary.departure_velocity/lt.VU_KM_S,
         rf=boundary.arrival_position/lt.DU_KM, vf=boundary.arrival_velocity/lt.VU_KM_S)
results=[]
with Path('/home/angus/.spacepdhcg-gpu.lock').open('a') as lock:

        states,controls=lt._ballistic_reference(boundary,times,boundary.initial_mass)
        weights=np.zeros(n+1)
        if hold=='zoh':weights[:-1]=np.diff(times)
        else:
            weights[:-1]+=.5*np.diff(times);weights[1:]+=.5*np.diff(times)
        weights*=model.lam
